thesis: Revised this evening, against this morning's long call. The adoption story got better during the day - DTCC's collateral platform is targeting a Q4 commercial launch and Chainlink prices tokenised stocks on Coinbase - but the positioning data got worse: the whale I flagged has now sent 2.41M LINK (~$26.04M) to Coinbase over three weeks, not the single $7.6M transfer, and every wallet cohort has moved into net distribution for the first time since early June. Daily RSI14 near 76 with price above the upper Bollinger band is not a level to own more at. Hold the position and let the trailing stop work; adding here has no edge.
bull_case: The integration list keeps lengthening with named, dated counterparties: Bottomline bringing CCIP and CRE to 600+ banks handling over $16T in annual payments (4 Sep 2026); Circle's wrapped bitcoin using Chainlink Proof of Reserve (6 Sep 2026); Chainlink Data Feeds live on Tempo (4 Sep 2026); DTCC's collateral platform targeting a Q4 2026 commercial launch; Chainlink pricing tokenised stocks on Coinbase; Schwab adding LINK in coming months. LINK-linked spot ETF products logged four straight weeks of net inflows through 24 Aug 2026, cumulative past $145M. External quotes have LINK around $13.07-13.32 and up ~7.1% on the session, and the daily trend is unambiguously up. The position is well in profit from 12.24.
bear_case: The distribution is bigger and broader than this morning's memo assumed. The whale has sent 2.41M LINK (~$26.04M) to Coinbase over three weeks - sustained, not a one-off - and on-chain work reports every wallet cohort shifting into net distribution for the first time since early June. That is the supply side of a rally being handed to late buyers. Momentum is stretched past the packet's reading: external daily RSI14 near 76 against the packet's 69, with price above the upper Bollinger band at $12.96, a configuration that historically invites a pause at best. Sector flows still favour bitcoin over alts - inflows into ETH, SOL, XRP and Hyperliquid products fell 73-96% in the week ending 4 Sep while bitcoin funds took $986.9M - and the whole crypto market was down 0.73% on Monday with the weekend's altcoin gains stalling. Base rate from our own backtest (research/backtests/2026-09-06.md): the crypto sleeve returned -6.4% with Sharpe -0.15 and a 17% win rate over 75 trades. Nothing in this asset's fundamentals fixes a 17% win rate on entries taken at RSI 76.

invalidation: Flips long again on a daily close above 14.00 - a clean new high made after this distribution, not into it - with exchange inflows from the tracked whale stopping. The bear case confirms on a daily close below 12.00, the base of the breakout, which would also put price back inside the pre-rally range; the trailing stop sits at 10.79.
